lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Hi there. I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I didn't expect you to make it to the finals.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Congratulations.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: It wasn't all that hard.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I didn't realize it because I've only been playing against you,

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: but all the other participants are small potatoes in comparison.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I must admit that I've gotten a bit greedy.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I want to beat you,

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: and claim that prize over there.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I don't intend on losing today.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I'm going to win.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Big talk, but your face tells another story.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: You look awfully nervous.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge's expression darkens even more.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Looks like I was right on the money.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: This is unlike you.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Now then, let's decide on the game.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: I will spin the roulette wheel!

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Whoooosh*

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: At this rate, you may struggle with the mind games you're usually so good at.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: In fact, I think I'd actually prefer if we get one of those games, hehe.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge hopes that the wheel doesn't land on a game with a psychological bent.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Click*

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The roulette wheel stops.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Oh, it's a game that goes wonderfully with the spirit of this competition!

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: A game that Rouge, the Game Master, is most confident in!

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Catch the Thief!

lines.speaker: audience01
lines.text: Whooooooo!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: That's the game we practiced yesterday,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: but can I do it?

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge feels herself becoming more and more discouraged, and has the sense that her bad luck is starting to accumulate.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Oh wow, I didn't actually expect them to pick the game I wanted!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: This should be fun.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Looks like Lady Luck is on my side today.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Luck...

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Well, shall we begin?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: ... All right.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The two sit at the game table with looks of intense concentration as they begin the game.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: After several rounds,

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge hasn't won a single game.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: This is starting to get boring.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: You can't even keep a straight face. This is way too easy.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: I'm practically being handed victory on a silver platter.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The woman chortles loudly and fidgets constantly.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge finds her movements befuddling.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: It's so strange... I thought I had her figured out.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: She's fidgeting too much, and her movements are so erratic.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: It's hard to tell which gesture means what.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: None of her movements connect with the other.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Or could it be that I'm just unlucky today?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I promised myself not to worry about luck while playing.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Highroller showed me how there's no relation

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: between luck and the outcome of any given game.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: It's not over until it's over.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: It's not too late.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I have to believe in myself.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I'll find an opening. I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: What are you mumbling to yourself about?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: It's your turn.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: At the last moment, Rouge catches a glimpse of the woman's movement.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: ... That's it.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Slide*

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The card she draws is not the Joker.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Hmph. You got lucky that time.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Well, it would have hardly been fun if it had been a washout.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Let's move on to the next round.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Finally. I've got her.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I need to focus on that one specific action of hers.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I need to keep my head in the game.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A few rounds later,

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge has caught up with her opponent, and the score is tied.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: One final round remains.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Whooooosh*

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge starts shuffling her cards with her trademark flair

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: This will be the last game.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: What's that expression for?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: You look like you've already won.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Because I have. I'm going to be the winner.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: You were a tough opponent, perhaps due to the fact that you're a regular.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: You surprise me.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: What? What did I do?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: You knew how I observe the subtle movements of my opponents, looking for tells,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: so you intentionally added as many unnecessary movements as possible.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I let my guard down.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Since you're a regular, I thought I'd figure you out quickly and win.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: But it was precisely the opposite.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I hadn't counted on you having me figured out as well.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: It nearly cost me my victory.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: But I've got your number now.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I've figured out all your moves.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I know what you do when you feel nervous,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: and what you do when you're at ease.

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: H-how did...?!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I recalled your movements when you played with me

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: before the finals.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: You were surprisingly easy to see through.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: This match is mine to win.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I have this in the bag.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rouge deals the cards calmly.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Slide*

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I win.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: My goodness! I can hardly believe my eyes!

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: The Game Master has pulled off a dramatic comeback!

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: It's a victory for Rouge!

lines.speaker: audience01
lines.text: Whoooohoooo!

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Crash*

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Th-this can't be!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: You won by reading my gestures? That doesn't make any sense!

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Did you use some kind of trick that only Nikkes can use?

lines.speaker: fancyfemale
lines.text: Or have you got some lucky charm tucked away in your pocket somewhere?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I've said it before, and I'll say it again: No.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I've recently come to a major revelation.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: When you're playing a game, luck really doesn't matter much.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: The important thing is skill.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: That's the difference between you and me.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: With that, the finals end with Rouge emerging victorious.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: After the award ceremony.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: There you are, Pit Boss!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I knew Rouge could do it!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: I was so nervous during that last match. My hands were shaking.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: I'm so glad she won!

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Where's Rouge now? I want to congratulate her.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I saw her over by the Game Zone.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: She was talking with some guests who came to congratulate her.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: We're on our way back from congratulating her ourselves.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: You should hurry.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: All right, I'll be back.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge is in front of a game table crowded with guests.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She is showing off various card flourishes.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: ... Hmm?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: My apologies, but if you'll excuse me,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I have to attend to a VIP guest.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge approaches me.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Hello, Highroller.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Congratulations.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You were amazing.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Thank you... truly.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I don't have the words to express my gratitude.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I was ready to give up. To close myself off to the rest of the world.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: But you reached out to me, and encouraged me to keep pushing forward.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: You have no idea how much strength you've given me.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: When I was on the brink of giving up, your advice played a huge role.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: These past few days with you have been invaluable.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Thanks to you, I got my coin back.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rouge shows me the coin with a rabbit emblem on the front side.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Do you feel more at ease now?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Yes, absolutely.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I feel like I can overcome any adversity that comes my way.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I'm brimming with confidence.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: On top of that, I've realized that while playing a game, luck in fact has a very minimal influence.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I've grown immeasurably more confident in my skills.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Ah, and there's this.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Hmm? A die?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: It's the lucky die that was the prize for the tournament.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I have my coin, so I don't think I'll be needing this.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I want to give it to you as a gift.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Will you accept it?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Since I'm already here, maybe I'll enjoy some games before I leave.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: That's a great idea.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Will you wait a moment?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I'd love nothing more than to play a game with you right now, but

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I've got a lot of customers waiting for me.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Let me go talk to them and I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Okay. I'll be waiting here for you.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Oh, by the way,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I'm definitely going to win.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: After all that practice you and I have done,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I know all your tells like the back of my hand.
